EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, an Eliza Cloud URL, a Voyage proxy, or a local TEI/Infinity/vLLM server). Setting this (or EMBEDDING_API_KEY) is what activates the plugin.

EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: Bearer token for the embedding endpoint. Setting this (or EMBEDDING_BASE_URL) is what activates the plugin. Omit for local servers that need no auth.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model identifier sent as the request `model` field.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_BASE_URL.description: Optional fallback OpenAI-compatible /embeddings base URL. Used once when the primary endpoint fails with a network, HTTP, or response-shape error. Does not activate the plugin by itself.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_API_KEY.description: Bearer token for the fallback embedding endpoint. Omit for fallback servers that need no auth.

EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Fallback embedding model identifier. Defaults to EMBEDDING_MODEL when unset. The fallback result must still match EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.

EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.description: Vector width. Must be one of 384, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072. Keep this stable for the lifetime of a database — changing it invalidates stored vectors.
